title: List and extract a portfolio collection through pdfxi portfolio
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-core --lib links and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi portfolio lists folder paths, media types, sizes and descriptions from a real portfolio and --extract writes the exact embedded bytes into recreated folders while refusing traversal; VIEW-014 moves to verified.
notes: Reads /Collection presence and every /Names /EmbeddedFiles entry with its /UF folder path, embedded-stream /Subtype and /Params /ModDate, then lists the collection rows and extracts the bytes with per-component path validation.
